name: Ten Signets for War Supplies
summary: Warlord Gorchuk trades Horde Commendation Signets for war supplies in Orgrimmar. Champions give up formal recognition for equipment that can help keep soldiers supplied at the front.

sections.title: Materiel for the Front
sections.body: Warlord Gorchuk oversees the Horde's supplies in the Valley of Spirits. As the Horde gathers its legions, weapons, rations, and armor must reach the front. Champions who have proved their dedication can trade commendation signets for useful equipment drawn from the army's reserves.

sections.title: Practical Survival over Glory
sections.body: Horde Commendation Signets usually prove a soldier's service and bring prestige with the leadership. Trading them for gear gives up that formal recognition for the chance to survive the fighting. Gorchuk knows that a satchel of supplies or a sturdy weapon can mean the difference between life and death when armies clash.

faq.answer: Horde Commendation Signets are tokens awarded to champions who gather raw materials and resources for the Horde's war preparations.
Warlord Gorchuk is a Horde logistics officer in Orgrimmar who collects war resources and distributes provisions to troops preparing for battle.

faq.q: Why turn signets in for supplies instead of faction reputation?
faq.answer: Trading signets for supplies gives up political standing and formal recognition in exchange for useful items, bandages, and gear for survival on the front lines.
Yes. Warlord Gorchuk continues trading field supplies as long as you have the required batches of commendation signets.

faq.q: Where does this exchange take place?
faq.answer: The exchange takes place in Orgrimmar, where the Horde centers its war preparations and stockpiles.

faq.q: What kind of war is the Horde preparing for?
faq.answer: The Horde is gathering metal, cloth, herbs, and rations for an expeditionary force to face an impending cataclysmic threat.

angles.text: Every crate gathered in Orgrimmar helps prepare the Horde for the battles ahead.
As a warrior, you know cold steel and ample rations help win long wars as surely as courage in battle.
